name: San Pasqual Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: San Pasqual Valley was San Diego County's first AVA, approved in 1981, and sits within the South Coast AVA. It covers a narrow valley running inland from Escondido.
